let waistband_cut_width: length = 2 * wb_width + sa_waist + sa_wb_bottom
column2: (bind waistband_cut_width length (+ (+ (* count:2 wb_width) sa_waist) sa_wb_bottom))

column1: let waistband_pattern_length: length = garment_waist + 2 * sa_cb + wb_extension
column2: (bind waistband_pattern_length length (+ (+ garment_waist (* count:2 sa_cb)) wb_extension))
(bind dart_count count (if (> dart_intake dart_intake_max) count:2 count:1))

column1: assert allocation_balance: eps_num = 4 * (ss_suppress + dart_intake) == garment_hip - garment_waist
column2: (assert allocation_balance eps_num (* count:4 (+ ss_suppress dart_intake)) (- garment_hip garment_waist))

column1: assert waist_closure: eps_num = (quarter_hip - ss_suppress) - dart_intake == quarter_waist
column2: (assert waist_closure eps_num (- (- quarter_hip ss_suppress) dart_intake) quarter_waist)

column1: assert waistband_length_closure: eps_num = waistband_pattern_length - 2 * sa_cb - wb_extension == garment_waist
column2: (assert waistband_length_closure eps_num (- (- waistband_pattern_length (* count:2 sa_cb)) wb_extension) garment_waist)

column1: assert waistband_width_closure: eps_num = waistband_cut_width - sa_waist - sa_wb_bottom == 2 * wb_width
column2: (assert waistband_width_closure eps_num (- (- waistband_cut_width sa_waist) sa_wb_bottom) (* count:2 wb_width))
